output_list.criticism: The mintToken function allows an attacker to mint an arbitrary large amount of tokens, which can cause a denial of service by making the totalSupply impossibly large.
The _transfer function decreases the balanceOf[_from] by _value, and increases the balanceOf[_to] by _value, which can cause a denial of service to the _from user.

The transfer function calls the _transfer function, which has an integer overflow vulnerability. If the balanceOf[msg.sender] is small, and _value is large, the balanceOf[msg.sender] will be set to zero, and the attacker can cause a denial of service to the msg.sender.
